brief_summary: The purpose of the trial is to evaluate the effect of Chiglitazar added to metformin to type 2 diabetes Inadequately controlled with metformin Monotherapy.
brief_title: Chiglitazar Added to Metformin for Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A Randomised Double-blind Placebo Parallel Controlled Phase Ⅲ Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Chiglitazar Added to Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Inadequately Controlled With Metformin Monotherapy (RECAM)

primary_outcomes.measure: percentage of HbA1c change from baseline
